description: Partial overrides for built-in agent definitions. Only specified fields override the Go-code defaults at seed time.

json_schema.label: Agent Override Config

agent_name.description: Built-in agent name to override (e.g. diane-default)

model_max_tokens.description: Override model max tokens (0 = keep built-in)

timeout.description: Override timeout in seconds (0 = keep built-in)

sandbox_enabled.description: Override sandbox enabled state (null = keep built-in)

json_schema.description: Maps agent names to partial override fields applied at seed time

description: Tracks the last time diane-skill-monitor checked completed sessions for skill extraction

json_schema.label: Skill Monitor Checkpoint

last_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last monitor run

agent_name.description: The agent this checkpoint tracks runs for (e.g. diane-default)

json_schema.description: Tracks skill monitor checkpoints for periodic session review

description: Audit log entry for system operations — agent CRUD, MCP management, tool config changes. Written by all Diane nodes for observability and debugging.

json_schema.label: Operation Log

op.description: Operation name: agent.delete, agent.seed, agent.override, agent.create, agent.update, mcp.add, mcp.remove, mcp.update, tool.config, override.create, override.update

target.description: What was acted on (agent name, MCP server name, entity ID)

actor.description: Who performed the operation: cli, local-api, watch, user:{name}

node.description: Diane instance hostname that performed the operation

json_schema.description: Audit log written by all Diane nodes for cross-instance observability

description: Maps a Discord channel/thread to a Memory Platform session ID, persisted in the system namespace for cross-instance durability

json_schema.label: Discord Channel Map
json_schema.description: Maps a Discord channel/thread to a Memory Platform session ID
